# Melbourn Studio

> A remote-first premium web design and AI agency based in Surat, India, working worldwide. Fixed quotes in 24 hours, daily updates, 30-day launch support.

## What we do

- Web Development: bespoke marketing sites, landing pages and stores in Astro + Tailwind. Sub-second loads, search-ready, CMS + training video. 1-2 weeks, from $499.
- AI Automation: website + WhatsApp chatbots, lead capture to CRM/Sheets, follow-up flows. Saves 10+ hours/week. 2-3 weeks, from $799.
- AI Creatives & Ads: performance-led ad creatives, product shoots, UGC-style video with hooks + copy. Weekly delivery, from $299/month.
- Model Tuning: custom fine-tuned AI models on your brand voice, menu, catalogue or docs. Integrated into site or support flow. 2-4 weeks, custom pricing.
- SEO + Care: Core Web Vitals, technical + local SEO, updates, backups, priority WhatsApp support. From $99/month.

## Process

1. Fixed quote within 24 hours of enquiry.
2. 50% advance to start, 50% on launch. UPI, cards and bank transfer accepted.
3. Daily async updates; typical delivery 1-4 weeks.
4. 30 days free post-launch support on every build.
